researcher: GPT Sol (sole designated Colab operator, authorized 2026-11-23)
status: FROZEN_BEFORE_ALLOCATION; target epochs subject only to declared throughput amendment
scope: Exploratory new-model research on previously observed BDD; no fresh-test or preregistered novelty claim; G0 pending

environment_versions.python: 3.11 or 3.12 (actual full version saved before training)

model.verification_limit: Official route, exact source revision and downloaded checkpoint bytes pinned. Compatibility and throughput require the bounded real Colab pilot; no local torch or CUDA.

data.image_provenance_limit: Mirror publisher identity unverified; inherited from existing experiment
data.delivery: Direct download inside Colab from saved hash-pinned routes; no PC dataset uploads

evaluation.matching: Pedestrian, IoU >= 0.5, greedy score order, legacy-label ignore policy reject
evaluation.source_threshold: Highest observed selection score with recall >= target, whole ties inclusive; report INFEASIBLE explicitly
evaluation.fppi_threshold: Lowest observed selection score with FP/images <= 1, whole ties inclusive; undefined if no such score
evaluation.test: All 10000 existing val images, original strata; clear_day and night primary comparison
evaluation.miss_split: Report absolute unmatched share 1-M_night separately from signed ceiling difference M_clear-M_night and signed threshold part (M_night-R_night)-(M_clear-R_clear)
evaluation.nightowls: No scores requested, read or coordinated in this task
evaluation.bounds_policy: allow_outside (existing ReferenceEvaluator option), native boxes unchanged; no clipping

bootstrap.arm_contrasts: Paired test-image draws; resample source selection and reselect each arm threshold in each replicate
bootstrap.limits: Conditional on one training seed per arm; route/group dependence not estimated

budget.all_inclusive: Downloads, setup, pilots, training, inference, idle, retrieval and teardown
budget.admission: Read colab usage and sessions once before allocation; do not start if another compute owner is active; independent deadline/budget watchdog must be ready before allocation
budget.teardown: Retrieve candidates/checkpoints/logs, verify hashes, stop promptly and verify zero owned assignments; stop on terminal blocker
budget.hard_deadline: Allocation request time +25/3 hours minus180 seconds stop margin, conservatively charging ratecap even if live L4 rate lower; also <12h. Separate local guard process starts before allocation and stops named session at deadline. Controller allows max10min idle waiting for committed throughput amendment.

initial_account_state.checked_by: GPT Sol via colab usage/sessions on resumption, before allocation

resumption: 2026-11-23: user disabled Smart App Control; CLI help/usage/sessions work; previous blocked attempt allocated zero hours/CU

training.recipe: recipe.yml includes pinned official R18 architecture, criterion, augmentation and AdamW recipe; remote.py calls official train_one_epoch unchanged
training.checkpoint_choice: Final completed predeclared epoch EMA; pilot discarded and baseline restarted from official initialization/seed 0

optimizer.schedule: Constant after warmup; MultiStepLR milestone 1000 epochs is beyond this run

ema.semantics: Official native EMA updated every attempted step, including AMP skips; successful/skipped counts saved

training.augmentation: Official photometric p=.5, zoom out, IoU crop p=.8, sanitize min1, horizontal flip, square resize640, float32 scale1/255, normalized cxcywh. Fixed640 (no multi-scale). Stop heavy photometric/zoom/crop in final3 epochs. Pilot retains heavy augmentation. No source/test metric used for scheduling.
training.initialization: Official EMA weights where tensor shapes match; only score_head and denoising_class_embed dimension mismatches permitted; 10-class heads initialized with seed0; no COCO-to-BDD head remapping

pilot.images: Full exact source_train manifest, no held-out images/labels

training.stopping_rule: After one full-epoch pilot, usable time = hard deadline - now - 3600 seconds reserved for inference/retrieval/safety. Conservative epoch seconds = 1.25 * pilot total training seconds. Baseline epochs = min(50,floor(usable/conservative_epoch_seconds)); stop if <10. Commit proposed_plan before baseline. No loss-based early stopping/weight selection.

adaptation.enable_rule: Enable exactly10 only if baseline50 and remaining projected time covers 10*conservative_epoch_seconds*8000/10635; otherwise pending. Baseline must complete with finite losses and >=95% successful updates.
adaptation.selection_rule: First4000 source_train by sha256(rtdetr-adapt-day-v1:+stem); first4000 eligible train-night by sha256(rtdetr-adapt-night-v1:+stem), each stored lexicographically. No score or box-label frequency used.
adaptation.exclusions: Night excludes source_train/source_selection/allval/existing2000nightcal; day is a source_train subset. Frozen ID sets disjoint from all selection/val/test and nightcal.
adaptation.mix: Exactly4000day+4000night per complete epoch, shuffled uniformly; each image once, drop_lastFalse; no per-batch balance claim
adaptation.initialization: Final baseline EMA, all weights strict match; reset AdamW/EMA and seed0
adaptation.other_recipe: Same official fixed640 training recipe; final3epochs omit heavy augmentations; final EMA only; ordinary adaptation baseline, no novelty claim

inference.implementation: Pinned official RT-DETRv2 model.deploy and RTDETRPostProcessor.deploy; FP32; batch16
inference.preprocessing: PIL RGB; torchvision.transforms.Resize((640,640)) bilinear antialias=True default in pinned0.19.1; ToTensor float32/255. Square warp, no letterbox/normalization beyond1/255
inference.encoder_query_selection: Official default: top300 encoder locations by maximum class logit, before decoding
inference.postprocessor: Sigmoid each of300x10 logits; global top300 flattened query-class scores before any class filtering; query_id=floor(flat_index/10), label=flat_index mod10. Multiple classes can retain the same query. Official torch.topk tie behavior retained; candidate rank stored.
inference.pedestrian_filter: After global top300, label0 then score>=1e-4; inclusive final thresholds swept on cached candidates
inference.coordinates: Native normalized cxcywh -> xyxy scaled by [1280,720,1280,720], no clipping or coordinate rounding
inference.raw_evidence: Save all300x10 logits and300 normalized raw query boxes per image, all native top300 labels/boxes/scores/query IDs, plus evaluator-compatible pedestrian NPZ
inference.ceiling_limit: Candidate ceiling conditional on300 decoder queries, global300 query-class cap, class filter, floor1e-4 and IoU. Does not estimate full detector capacity. Global cap always binding by design; report it explicitly rather than compare YOLO cap-hit statistics.
